submissions.note: CEM v2: crop-led portfolio. The only submission id recorded anywhere before this ledger existed (docs/2). Issue #25 confirmed the local number overstated the ladder by ~25%: episodes 90069549 (64,625-54,216 W) and 90070208 (59,553-62,425 L).
CEM v3 on fixed code. Beat v2 91.7% head-to-head locally and scored LOWER on the ladder (645.3 vs 667.6). The first disagreement between local evidence and the ladder, unremarked at the time.
Multi-restart CEM sweep. 100% win vs the full opponent pool of the day, which was entirely our own lineage.
First champion trained against an opponent mixture rather than starter alone. Gate 2.3 sigma, floor +43%.

CEM ranked on MARGIN. 100% win vs all 8 frozen opponents; worst seed 52,764 vs v5's 33,768. Did NOT pass the gate (mean -384 against 1 sigma of 1,652) and was promoted on explicit override. Its 853.9 is the highest number in this column and is NOT evidence that v8 is our best agent: it held a slot for 2h45m, i.e. roughly 15 episodes, from a 600 start and still climbing, while v10 and v11 have had eleven days to converge. Re-measured 2026-08-17 on a fixed resolve_pool, v10 beats v8 on bank, floor, win rate and per-opponent margin across both the top and band pools without exception. Resolving the ladder question costs one submission and 36h of leaving it alone.

Late wheat rotation: mix_switch_day 28->16 (it was after wheat's own plant cutoff, so late_target_mult was dead code). Gated at +4,138 paired 13 sigma per docs/6, which REPRODUCES (+4,016 on 6 clean seeds, worst 45,519->50,195); DEVELOPMENTS.md's +4,500 / 48,827->54,012 does not and was a transcription error. Ladder 746.1 against the 853.9 it replaced, but see submission 55290443: that comparison is confounded by convergence time. The real finding is that v10 and v8 BOTH win 0% against the top band at a margin of ~-53,000, so a +4,000 bank delta cannot flip a single match. Note the 'real' pool was itself broken at the time: resolve_pool sorted frozen snapshots alphabetically and took the last two, so the reigning champion was never in it.

Diverse-archetype hedge for the second slot, replacing v8. 35.1% wins vs the band pool against v8's 25.6%. Statistically tied with v10 locally (+394, 0.20 sigma). Ladder 730.2. Never frozen at the time; RECOVERED 2026-08-17 from the stale submission.tar.gz at the repo root (mtime one minute before the submission, parameters matching its description exactly) and frozen as v11-hedge. Found by tests/test_submission.py::test_bundle_ships_the_promoted_params, which exists to stop a stale tarball shipping under a new version's message.

First champion selected against the top of the ladder. CEM 96x40 vs an 8-tape pool minted from 2026-08-16 episodes (incl. the current leader), 2 opponents held out, ranked on margin, warm-started from v10 at spread 0.22 after target_strawberry_tiles' ceiling moved 12->20; the search used it immediately (12->15), plus plant_crops_per_turn 1->3, first geese, wool sell floor 1.00->0.83 so it trades at all, rival-aware selling on. Band win rate 43.8% vs v10's 33.3% (8 clean seeds x 2 seats, paired); top-pool worst seed 56,912 vs 43,915; held-out-opponent delta +6,394 at 2 sigma. Mean bank flat (+211) on purpose. GATE FAILED its mean-by-1-sigma and beat-every-opponent checks; promoted on explicit override, as v8 was. Evicted v10 (741.7) from the scored pair, leaving v11 (730.2) as the floor until this converges.
